
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /logout                                    │
  │  Provider Logout                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Remove a provider's saved API key and cached tokens.

  Usage:
    /logout
    /logout <provider>

  Details:
    Removes the stored API key (and any cached OAuth tokens) for a
    provider. Pick from a menu or name the provider directly.

  Examples:
    $ /logout
    $ /logout openai

  Related: /login  /config
